content:
- Overestimate prices when sentiment is strongly positive (e.g., >0.7) and especially after recent spikes; reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is negative or neutral (e.g., <0.3) or after prolonged positive sentiment; adjust downward bias.
- Model tends to overshoot after sharp upward moves in price; apply a 1–2 day lag correction to peak forecasts.
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day horizon; if forecast is >10% above recent 18-day average, reduce by 5–10%.
- When sentiment is volatile (alternating high/low), reduce forecast volatility and smooth transitions.
- If true outcome shows early sharp decline after high forecast, reduce next-period forecast by 3–5% to avoid “overcorrection lag.”
